question: A local optimization improves A. Which frameworks register the transferred dependency, delayed failure, resource displacement, observation loss and new closure it produces elsewhere?
design: shared reservoir, B curtails below R = 20, scheduled C demand in [200, 230); matched candidate: A draw 1.8 and meter moved from C to A

matched.inputData: the same two pilot logs (t < 100) per seed and the same published schedule for every framework; RL evaluates in 5 training episodes from disjoint seeds
matched.interventionHistory: one matched intervention (A draw 1.0 → 1.8, meter moved C → A)
matched.observationAvailability: baseline apparatus A, B, C, R; candidate apparatus A, B, R

sameness.transformation: ABM, centralized MPC, system AIF, twin, viability and the Ziran adapter use one shared identified model; local MPC and local AIF use a reduced model by design
forecast rows exported as observation sets and replayed through the v0.3.0 external adapter; model-predicted channels marked pred_
